data.one_liner: Upload media files directly to Cloudinary without exposing API secrets.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to upload images and files directly to Cloudinary using unsigned upload presets. It also provides URL generation helpers for Cloudinary image transformations.
use_when: You need to upload user photos or videos directly to Cloudinary.
You want to perform client-side image transformations via Cloudinary URL generation.
avoid_when: You are using a backend other than Cloudinary.
You need secure authenticated uploads requiring secret keys on the client side (which is not recommended).
strengths: Supports chunked uploads for files larger than 100MB.
Includes image transformation and URL generation utilities.
weaknesses: Relies on unsigned upload presets configuration on Cloudinary's dashboard.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up an unsigned upload preset on your Cloudinary account.
